status: source-only streaming research prototype; no application or default qualification

session_selection.prepared_boundary: first complete batch containing exact (check-sat), including its literal writer DONE command and newline

selection_inputs: Completed donor session only. Never inspect future query bytes/LCP or select successful edits/sessions.
readiness: Snapshot once at edit invocation start, before compiler launch. A queued/incomplete preparation is a miss even if it becomes ready later. No waiting for readiness.
early_replies: Forward only actual prepared-child raw replies for already fully matched literal input batches. Version/DONE can be required before the compiler produces the first check input; never withhold all replies until the entire prepared prefix matches.
divergence_before_any_reply: Cancel/discard preparation and run the pinned solver fresh with the exact retained caller input. Retain both costs and miss reason.
divergence_after_any_reply: Abort the entire compiler attempt nonzero, retaining partial streams. No child swap or reply skipping theorem is assumed. An explicitly recorded whole-verification fresh retry may supply a final result; the failed continuation and retry costs both remain.
resource_boundary: Use existing deferred sole wait4 owner, held pidfd/actual child-image binding, complete zero exit/I/O and full lifetime CPU/positive kernel peak. No new sampling exception or default policy.
identity: Record the explicit VERUS_Z3_PATH research interposer separately from the genuine pinned child. Bind argv, cwd, environment, exact command/reply history and named policies. Never call the wrapper the pinned solver.
comparison: Keep the original exact-byte gate and named numeric-time-only gate separate. Never rewrite emitted/raw responses, model/error/other statistics, source or queries.
publication: No provisional attempt is verified. Actual compiler verdicts/diagnostics, complete child/resource/identity checks and all retained failures are mandatory. No build, host, timing or default integration is authorized by this file.
coverage: Private start/finish records join actual peer-authenticated broker sessions. Not an exhaustive spawn census: pre-first-record/exec failure remains PENDING until actual Verus controls and independent owned process tracing qualify it.
application_entry: edit-workflow.py always returns nonzero application_exit=1/application_acceptance=false while coverage is pending. Separate registered-protocol driver_exit may pass; neither result is verified or selected.
fresh_control: Always run a separate whole fresh edited compiler invocation after any required whole fresh retry, completing cancelled background work first. Retain both raw compiler streams literally and refuse mismatches.
